scope: R-008/A: two read-only loads of the display window before any DXE driver is dispatched
code_location: firmware/diagnostics/EnumaStageCheckpoint.h, inside the runtime branch if (Stage == 10), before MicroSecondDelay
why_this_location: the delay-control experiment proved this branch executes and honours ENUMA_DIAG_DELAY_US, so placing the reads in that same branch avoids depending on a macro reaching a particular translation unit
mapping: the R-004 device mapping for 0x0ae00000..0x0ae85 000 is installed by the time the DXE dispatcher runs, so a stall cannot be blamed on an unmapped address
build: build_enuma_firmware.py --stop-stage 10 --stop-delay 2 --dispatch-ordinal 1 --detail-point 13 --diagnostic-simplefb; audit and Boot v3 roundtrip pass

discrimination.stall: the window was already unreachable before any of our drivers ran, so the teardown belongs to XBL/ABL or to an earlier phase; B would have to start from RPMh and D1 becomes the only sensible route
discrimination.clean_return: the window was still reachable at this point, so the teardown happens later inside our own dispatch; B can then be much smaller (enable AHB/MDP clocks without touching RPMh)

repeat_rule: one trial first; a stall requires manual long-press recovery and stops further candidates
